description: Find quantum workload agents (providers, compilers, mitigators, verifiers, routers, meters) by what their cards state: backend modality and kind, physical qubits, circuit formats, jurisdiction and the verification rungs offered. Each result carries its index facets; the facts are the provider's signed claims, each with its as_of. Public. Listed where this registry's QUANTUM_WORKLOADS_MODE is shadow or on; under off it answers the switch's sentence.

format.description: A backend that takes this circuit format (openqasm3, qir, ...)

jurisdiction.description: A backend under this jurisdiction code (DE, US-CA, EU)

min_qubits.description: A backend with at least this many physical qubits

query.description: Words in the name, description or tags

role.description: An agent that holds this role

rung.description: A verification rung the agent offers

name: theprotocol_discoverQuantumAgents
title: Discover Quantum Agents
